Four copies here: (1) astro's and (2) miniflare's own bundled zod@3.25.76, used for this app's Astro content-collection schema (src/content.config.ts, a glob loader over site-owner-authored Markdown files under src/data/content) -- build-time only, no attacker input reaches it; covered by open PR #14's astro bump to 7.4.1. (3) @wix/feedback-loop-structure's zod@3.23.8 -- unused, see @wix/dashboard finding above. (4) The root-hoisted zod@4.4.3, required (^4.3.6) by 100+ @wix/auto_sdk_* packages that back this app's real, actively-used @wix/forms SDK -- this app's own API routes (src/pages/api/{preorder,newsletter,catering}.ts) do call `submissions.createSubmission()` with attacker-controlled request-body data, so this looked like a plausible reachable path. Checked directly: @wix/auto_sdk_forms_submissions bundles a zod-based schemas.js, but grepping the entire @wix/* dependency tree found zero imports of ./schemas from any package's actual runtime request-building code (index.js) -- the zod validation is dead code, never invoked when these SDK functions run. Not reachable via this path either. A real, safe fix for copy (4) is NOT currently applied: a blanket top-level `zod` override would force astro's and miniflare's own hard ^3.25.76 dependency onto a 4.x release, violating their declared range and risking real breakage (zod v3->v4 is an incompatible API change); scoping an override per-parent to avoid that is impractical across 100+ @wix/auto_sdk_* packages. Blocked until either astro drops its own zod v3 pin or @wix/auto_sdk_* bumps past zod v4.6.6 on its own (re-check next run).
